import math

class Merge(int a, int b, real64 height, int size)
class Edge(int parent, int child, real64 weight)
class Coefficients(real64 alpha_a, real64 alpha_b, real64 beta, real64 gamma)

Coefficients lance_williams(string method, int size_a, int size_b, int size_k)
    if method == "single"
        return Coefficients(0.5, 0.5, 0.0, -0.5)
    if method == "complete"
        return Coefficients(0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.5)
    if method == "average" or method == "centroid"
        combined := size_a + size_b
        beta := if method == "centroid" then -real64(size_a * size_b) / real64(combined * combined) else 0.0
        return Coefficients(real64(size_a) / real64(combined), real64(size_b) / real64(combined), beta, 0.0)
    if method == "weighted"
        return Coefficients(0.5, 0.5, 0.0, 0.0)
    if method == "median"
        return Coefficients(0.5, 0.5, -0.25, 0.0)
    total := size_a + size_b + size_k
    return Coefficients(real64(size_a + size_k) / real64(total), real64(size_b + size_k) / real64(total), -real64(size_k) / real64(total), 0.0)

Merge[] agglomerate(real64[][] delta, string method)
    count := int(#delta)
    capacity := 2 * count - 1
    squared := method == "centroid" or method == "median" or method == "ward"
    real64[][] values := array(nat(capacity), fill = array(nat(capacity), fill = 0.0))
    for: first < count
        for: second < count
            values[first][second] = if squared then delta[first][second] * delta[first][second] else delta[first][second]
    sizes := array(nat(capacity), fill = 1)
    active := 0:<count
    Merge[] merges := []
    for: step < count - 1
        first := active[0]
        second := active[1]
        for: position < int(#active)
            a := active[position]
            for b := active[position + 1:][]
                if values[a][b] < values[first][second]
                    first = a
                    second = b
        node := count + step
        sizes[node] = sizes[first] + sizes[second]
        real64 height := if squared then math.sqrt(values[first][second]) else values[first][second]
        merges = merges.append(Merge(first, second, height, sizes[node]))
        for other := active[]
            if other == first or other == second
                continue
            weights := lance_williams(method, sizes[first], sizes[second], sizes[other])
            value := weights.alpha_a * values[first][other] + weights.alpha_b * values[second][other] + weights.beta * values[first][second] + weights.gamma * math.abs(values[first][other] - values[second][other])
            values[node][other] = value
            values[other][node] = value
        active = [for cluster := active[] if cluster != first and cluster != second then cluster].append(node)
    return merges

Edge[] minimum_spanning_tree(real64[][] delta)
    count := int(#delta)
    inside := array(nat(count), fill = false)
    inside[0] = true
    keys := delta[0]
    parents := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    Edge[] edges := []
    for: step < count - 1
        chosen := -1
        for: vertex < count
            if not inside[vertex] and (chosen < 0 or keys[vertex] < keys[chosen])
                chosen = vertex
        inside[chosen] = true
        edges = edges.append(Edge(parents[chosen], chosen, keys[chosen]))
        for: vertex < count
            if not inside[vertex] and delta[chosen][vertex] < keys[vertex]
                keys[vertex] = delta[chosen][vertex]
                parents[vertex] = chosen
    return edges

class Observation(string ident, string label, real64[] values)
class Observations(string[] names, Observation[] rows)

string[] read_lines(string path)
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    return lines[0:<int(#lines) - 1]

Observations read_observations(string path)
    lines := read_lines(path)
    names := lines[0].split(",")[2:]
    Observation[] rows := []
    for line := lines[1:][]
        fields := line.split(",")
        rows = rows.append(Observation(fields[0], fields[1], [for value := fields[2:][] then real64(value)]))
    return Observations(names, rows)

class Settings(local string[][] rows)
    string distance := rows[0][1]
    string standardize := rows[1][1]
    string[] linkages := rows[2][1:]
    real64[] cut_heights := [for value := rows[3][1:][] then real64(value)]
    int[] cut_counts := [for value := rows[4][1:][] then int(value)]
    inconsistency_depth := int(rows[5][1])
    inconsistency_count := int(rows[5][2])
    gap_max_k := int(rows[6][1])
    list_size := int(rows[7][1])
    width := int(rows[8][1])
    string compare_linkage := rows[9][1]
    replicates := int(rows[10][1])
    percent := int(rows[10][2])
    seed := int(rows[10][3])
    refine_iterations := int(rows[11][1])

Settings read_settings(string path)
    return Settings([for line := read_lines(path)[] then line.split(" ")])

void write_lines(string path, string[] lines)
    writer1 := file.write(path)
    .writer1(if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL)

import math
import agg = "./agglomerative.qui"

int[][] ordered_children(agg.Merge[] merges, int count)
    minimum := 0:<count
    int[][] children := []
    for merge := merges[]
        children = children.append(if minimum[merge.a] < minimum[merge.b] then [merge.a, merge.b] else [merge.b, merge.a])
        minimum = minimum.append(math.min(minimum[merge.a], minimum[merge.b]))
    return children

int[] leaf_order(int[][] children, int count)
    int[] order := []
    pending := [count + int(#children) - 1]
    while #pending != 0
        node := pending[-1]
        pending = pending[0:<int(#pending) - 1]
        if node < count
            order = order.append(node)
        else
            pair := children[node - count]
            pending = pending.concat([pair[1], pair[0]])
    return order

int column(real64 height, real64 maximum, int width)
    position := height / maximum * real64(width)
    if position >= real64(width + 1)
        return width + 1
    result := math.floor(position)
    return result

void mark(int[][] &grid, int row, int x, int priority)
    grid[row][x] = math.max(grid[row][x], priority)

string[] dendrogram_rows(agg.Merge[] merges, int[][] children, int[] order, string[] idents, string[] labels, real64 maximum, int[] cuts, int width)
    count := int(#order)
    int[][] grid := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(width + 1), fill = 0))
    anchor := array(nat(2 * count - 1), fill = 0)
    for: row < count
        anchor[order[row]] = row
    for x := cuts[]
        if x <= width
            for: row < count
                mark(&grid, row, x, 1)
    columns := [for merge := merges[] then column(merge.height, maximum, width)]
    for: step < int(#children)
        upper := children[step][0]
        lower := children[step][1]
        x := columns[step]
        mark(&grid, anchor[upper], x, 4)
        mark(&grid, anchor[lower], x, 4)
        for: anchor[upper] + 1 <= row < anchor[lower]
            mark(&grid, row, x, 3)
        for child := children[step][]
            start := if child < count then 0 else columns[child - count] + 1
            for: start <= position < x
                mark(&grid, anchor[child], position, 2)
        anchor[count + step] = (anchor[upper] + anchor[lower]) / 2
    id_width := [for ident := idents[] then #ident].max()
    label_width := [for label := labels[] then #label].max()
    marks := " :-|+"
    string[] rows := []
    for: row < count
        leaf := order[row]
        cells := [for priority := grid[row][] then marks[priority]].join("")
        string text := idents[leaf] + " " * (id_width - #idents[leaf]) + " " + labels[leaf] + " " * (label_width - #labels[leaf]) + " " + cells
        while text.ends_with(" ")
            text = text[0:<int(#text) - 1]
        rows = rows.append(text)
    scale := [for x := (0:width)[] then if x % 10 == 0 then "+" else "-"].join("")
    return rows.append(" " * (id_width + label_width + 2) + scale)

import math

string[] types()
    return ["euclidean", "manhattan", "correlation"]

real64 squared(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    return ((first - second) * (first - second)).sum()

class Statistics(local real64[][] rows)
    real64[] means := []
    real64[] deviations := []
    for: feature < #rows[0]
        column := [for row := rows[] then row[feature]]
        mean_value := column.sum() / real64(#rows)
        spread := ((column - mean_value) * (column - mean_value)).sum() / real64(int(#rows) - 1)
        means = means.append(mean_value)
        deviations = deviations.append(math.sqrt(spread))

real64[][] standardize(real64[][] rows, real64[] means, real64[] deviations)
    return [for row := rows[] then (row - means) / deviations]

real64 distance(real64[] first, real64[] second, string kind)
    if kind == "euclidean"
        return math.sqrt(squared(first, second))
    if kind == "manhattan"
        return math.abs(first - second).sum()
    mean_first := first.sum() / real64(#first)
    mean_second := second.sum() / real64(#second)
    centered_first := first - mean_first
    centered_second := second - mean_second
    cross := (centered_first * centered_second).sum()
    spread := (centered_first * centered_first).sum() * (centered_second * centered_second).sum()
    return 1.0 - cross / math.sqrt(spread)

real64[][] distance_matrix(real64[][] vectors, string kind)
    count := int(#vectors)
    real64[][] matrix := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = 0.0))
    for: first < count
        for: first + 1 <= second < count
            value := distance(vectors[first], vectors[second], kind)
            matrix[first][second] = value
            matrix[second][first] = value
    return matrix

import math
import data = "./dataset.qui"
import metric = "./distances.qui"
import agg = "./agglomerative.qui"
import drawing = "./dendrogram.qui"
import validation = "./validation.qui"

string real_text(real64 | none value)
    match value
        real64
            formatted := "{value:.4}"
            return if formatted == "-0.0000" then "0.0000" else formatted
        none
            return "-"

string reals(real64[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then real_text(value)].join(" ")

string integers(int[] values)
    return [for value := values[] then "{value}"].join(" ")

real64 rounded_key(real64 value)
    rounded := real64(real_text(value))
    return rounded

real64 | error required_real(real64 | none value)
    match value
        real64
            return value
        none
            return error("missing clustering metric")

string ari_text(validation.Fraction fraction)
    return "{fraction.numerator}/{fraction.denominator} {real_text(fraction.value())}"

real64[] pair_values(real64[][] matrix)
    real64[] values := []
    for: first < int(#matrix)
        for: first + 1 <= second < int(#matrix)
            values = values.append(matrix[first][second])
    return values

int histogram_bin(real64 value, real64 maximum)
    position := math.floor(10.0 * value / maximum)
    return math.min(9, position)

real64[] centroid(real64[][] vectors)
    return [for feature := (0:<int(#vectors[0]))[] then [for vector := vectors[] then vector[feature]].sum() / real64(#vectors)]

int[][] cluster_members(int[] partition, int groups)
    int[] empty := []
    int[][] members := array(nat(groups), fill = empty)
    for: position < int(#partition)
        members[partition[position] - 1] = members[partition[position] - 1].append(position)
    return members

int majority_class(int[] row)
    best := 0
    for: 1 <= category < int(#row)
        if row[category] > row[best]
            best = category
    return best

string[] join_parts(string[][] parts)
    string[] lines := []
    for part := parts[]
        if #lines > 0
            lines = lines.append("")
        lines = lines.concat(part)
    return lines

class Minstd(int state)
    int .draw()
        state = 48271 * state % 2147483647
        return state

class Tree(agg.Merge[] merges, int count)
    real64[] heights := [for merge := merges[] then merge.height]
    int[][] children := drawing.ordered_children(merges, count)
    int[] order := drawing.leaf_order(children, count)
    int[][] members := [for leaf := (0:<count)[] then [leaf]]
    depths := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    real64[] subtree_heights := []
    for merge := merges[]
        members = members.append(members[merge.a].concat(members[merge.b]))
        depths = depths.append(1 + math.max(depths[merge.a], depths[merge.b]))
        first_height := if merge.a < count then 0.0 else subtree_heights[merge.a - count]
        second_height := if merge.b < count then 0.0 else subtree_heights[merge.b - count]
        subtree_heights = subtree_heights.append(math.max(merge.height, math.max(first_height, second_height)))

    real64 height_of(int node)
        return if node < count then 0.0 else heights[node - count]

    int[] partition(bool[] selected)
        owner := 0:<count
        for: step < int(#selected)
            if selected[step]
                for leaf := members[count + step][]
                    owner[leaf] = count + step
        numbers := array(nat(2 * count - 1), fill = 0)
        groups := 0
        for leaf := order[]
            if numbers[owner[leaf]] == 0
                groups += 1
                numbers[owner[leaf]] = groups
        return [for node := owner[] then numbers[node]]

    int[] cut_height(real64 height)
        return partition([for value := subtree_heights[] then value <= height])

    int[] cut_into(int groups)
        return partition([for step := (0:<int(#merges))[] then step < count - groups])

    real64[][] cophenetic()
        real64[][] matrix := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = 0.0))
        for merge := merges[]
            for first := members[merge.a][]
                for second := members[merge.b][]
                    matrix[first][second] = merge.height
                    matrix[second][first] = merge.height
        return matrix

    real64[] joining_heights()
        real64[] values := array(nat(count), fill = 0.0)
        for merge := merges[]
            for child := [merge.a, merge.b][]
                if child < count
                    values[child] = merge.height
        return values

    real64[] height_sequence(int step, int depth)
        if depth == 0
            return []
        merge := merges[step]
        sequence := [merge.height]
        for child := [merge.a, merge.b][]
            if child >= count
                sequence = sequence.concat(height_sequence(child - count, depth - 1))
        return sequence

    string newick(int node, string[] idents)
        if node < count
            return idents[node]
        string[] branches := []
        for child := children[node - count][]
            branches = branches.append(newick(child, idents) + ":" + real_text(height_of(node) - height_of(child)))
        return "(" + branches.join(",") + ")"

class Evaluation(int[] partition, int[] sizes, real64 | none silhouette, real64 | none dunn, real64 wss, real64 | none ch, validation.Fraction ari)
    string text()
        return "sizes {integers(sizes)} silhouette {real_text(silhouette)} dunn {real_text(dunn)} wss {real_text(wss)} ch {real_text(ch)} ari {ari_text(ari)}"

class LinkageResult(string method, Tree tree, real64[] cophenetic, real64 correlation, Evaluation[] height_cuts, Evaluation[] count_cuts, int[] label_partition)

class Study(local data.Observations observations, data.Settings settings)
    string[] names := observations.names
    count := int(#observations.rows)
    string[] idents := [for row := observations.rows[] then row.ident]
    string[] labels := [for row := observations.rows[] then row.label]
    string[] classes := []
    int[] targets := []
    real64[][] raw := [for row := observations.rows[] then row.values]
    local statistics := metric.Statistics(raw)
    real64[] means := statistics.means
    real64[] deviations := statistics.deviations
    real64[][] vectors := if settings.standardize == "yes" then metric.standardize(raw, means, deviations) else raw
    real64[][] delta := metric.distance_matrix(vectors, settings.distance)
    distance_pairs := pair_values(delta)
    real64 distance_max := distance_pairs.max()
    int[] neighbors := []
    LinkageResult[] results := []
    chosen := 0
    position := 0
    kappa := 0
    int[] selected := []
    int[][] members := []
    real64[] silhouettes := []
    int[][] table := []
    int[] majority := []
    for label := labels.sorted()[]
        if #classes == 0 or classes[-1] != label
            classes = classes.append(label)
    for label := labels[]
        for: category < int(#classes)
            if classes[category] == label
                targets = targets.append(category)
                break
    for: observation < count
        neighbors = neighbors.append(nearest_neighbor(observation))
    for method := settings.linkages[]
        results = results.append(analyse(method))
    for: result < int(#results)
        for: candidate < int(#settings.cut_counts)
            if results[result].count_cuts[candidate].ari.greater(results[chosen].count_cuts[position].ari)
                chosen = result
                position = candidate
    kappa = settings.cut_counts[position]
    selected = results[chosen].count_cuts[position].partition
    members = cluster_members(selected, kappa)
    silhouettes = validation.silhouette_values(selected, kappa, delta)
    table = class_table(selected)
    majority = [for row := table[] then majority_class(row)]

    int nearest_neighbor(int observation)
        best := -1
        for: other < count
            if other != observation and (best < 0 or delta[observation][other] < delta[observation][best])
                best = other
        return best

    int[][] class_table(int[] partition)
        return validation.contingency(partition - 1, targets, partition.max(), int(#classes))

    validation.Fraction label_ari(int[] partition)
        return validation.adjusted_rand(class_table(partition))

    int match_count(int[] partition)
        return [for row := class_table(partition)[] then row.max()].sum()

    validation.Fraction partition_ari(int[] first, int[] second)
        return validation.adjusted_rand(validation.contingency(first - 1, second - 1, first.max(), second.max()))

    real64 | none mean_silhouette(int[] partition, real64[][] distances)
        groups := partition.max()
        return if groups < 2 then none else validation.silhouette_values(partition, groups, distances).sum() / real64(#partition)

    real64[][] centroids(int[] partition)
        groups := cluster_members(partition, partition.max())
        return [for group := groups[] then centroid([for observation := group[] then vectors[observation]])]

    real64 within_sum(int[] partition)
        real64[][] centers := centroids(partition)
        return [for observation := (0:<count)[] then metric.squared(vectors[observation], centers[partition[observation] - 1])].sum()

    Evaluation evaluate(int[] partition)
        groups := partition.max()
        group_list := cluster_members(partition, groups)
        sizes := [for group := group_list[] then int(#group)]
        real64 wss := within_sum(partition)
        real64 diameter := 0.0
        real64 gap_between := inf
        for: first < count
            for: first + 1 <= second < count
                if partition[first] == partition[second]
                    diameter = math.max(diameter, delta[first][second])
                else
                    gap_between = math.min(gap_between, delta[first][second])
        real64 | none ch := none
        if 2 <= groups < count
            overall := centroid(vectors)
            real64[][] centers := centroids(partition)
            bss := [for group := (0:<groups)[] then real64(sizes[group]) * metric.squared(centers[group], overall)].sum()
            ch = bss / real64(groups - 1) / (wss / real64(count - groups))
        real64 | none dunn := if groups >= 2 and diameter > 0.0 then gap_between / diameter else none
        return Evaluation(partition, sizes, mean_silhouette(partition, delta), dunn, wss, ch, label_ari(partition))

    LinkageResult analyse(string method)
        tree := Tree(agg.agglomerate(delta, method), count)
        cophenetic := pair_values(tree.cophenetic())
        Evaluation[] height_cuts := [for height := settings.cut_heights[] then evaluate(tree.cut_height(height))]
        Evaluation[] count_cuts := [for clusters := settings.cut_counts[] then evaluate(tree.cut_into(clusters))]
        return LinkageResult(method, tree, cophenetic, validation.correlation(distance_pairs, cophenetic), height_cuts, count_cuts, tree.cut_into(int(#classes)))

    string[] linkage_table()
        lines := ["method,step,a,b,height,size"]
        for result := results[]
            for: step < int(#result.tree.merges)
                merge := result.tree.merges[step]
                lines = lines.append("{result.method},{step + 1},{merge.a},{merge.b},{real_text(merge.height)},{merge.size}")
        return lines

    string[] clusters_table()
        header := ["id", "label"]
        for result := results[]
            for: cut < int(#settings.cut_heights)
                header = header.append("{result.method}_h{cut + 1}")
            for clusters := settings.cut_counts[]
                header = header.append("{result.method}_k{clusters}")
        lines := [header.join(",")]
        for: observation < count
            fields := [idents[observation], labels[observation]]
            for result := results[]
                for cut := result.height_cuts.concat(result.count_cuts)[]
                    fields = fields.append("{cut.partition[observation]}")
            lines = lines.append(fields.join(","))
        return lines

    string[] dendrogram_report()
        string[][] blocks := []
        for result := results[]
            tree := result.tree
            maximum := tree.heights.max()
            cuts := [for height := settings.cut_heights[] then drawing.column(height, maximum, settings.width)]
            lines := ["dendrogram {result.method} height_max {real_text(maximum)} width {settings.width}"]
            lines = lines.concat(drawing.dendrogram_rows(tree.merges, tree.children, tree.order, idents, labels, maximum, cuts, settings.width))
            for: cut < int(#cuts)
                column_text := if cuts[cut] <= settings.width then "{cuts[cut]}" else "-"
                lines = lines.append("cut {real_text(settings.cut_heights[cut])} column {column_text}")
            blocks = blocks.append(lines)
        return join_parts(blocks)

    string[] trees_report()
        return [for result := results[] then "{result.method} {result.tree.newick(2 * count - 2, idents)};"]

    string pair_text(int first, int second)
        return "{real_text(delta[first][second])} {idents[first]} {idents[second]}"

    string[] data_part()
        lines := ["data n {count} features {#names} classes {#classes} distance {settings.distance} standardize {settings.standardize}"]
        for: feature < int(#names)
            lines = lines.append("feature {names[feature]} mean {real_text(means[feature])} sd {real_text(deviations[feature])}")
        smallest := [0, 1]
        largest := [0, 1]
        for: first < count
            for: first + 1 <= second < count
                if delta[first][second] < delta[smallest[0]][smallest[1]]
                    smallest = [first, second]
                if delta[first][second] > delta[largest[0]][largest[1]]
                    largest = [first, second]
        nearest_mean := [for observation := (0:<count)[] then delta[observation][neighbors[observation]]].sum() / real64(count)
        reciprocal := [for observation := (0:<count)[] if observation < neighbors[observation] and neighbors[neighbors[observation]] == observation then 1].sum()
        lines = lines.append("distances pairs {#distance_pairs} min {pair_text(smallest[0], smallest[1])} max {pair_text(largest[0], largest[1])} mean {real_text(distance_pairs.sum() / real64(#distance_pairs))}")
        lines = lines.append("nearest_neighbors mean {real_text(nearest_mean)} reciprocal_pairs {reciprocal}")
        return lines.append("labels {evaluate(targets + 1).text()}")

    string[] correlation_part()
        columns := [for feature := (0:<int(#names))[] then [for row := raw[] then row[feature]]]
        lines := ["correlation " + names.join(" ")]
        for: feature < int(#names)
            lines = lines.append(names[feature] + " " + reals([for column := columns[] then validation.correlation(columns[feature], column)]))
        return lines

    string[] histogram_part()
        counts := array(10, fill = 0)
        for value := distance_pairs[]
            counts[histogram_bin(value, distance_max)] += 1
        highest := counts.max()
        lines := ["histogram"]
        for: bin_number < 10
            frequency := counts[bin_number]
            length := frequency * 50 / highest
            string bar := if length > 0 then " " + "#" * nat(length) else ""
            lines = lines.append("{real_text(real64(bin_number) * distance_max / 10.0)} {real_text(real64(bin_number + 1) * distance_max / 10.0)} {frequency}{bar}")
        return lines

    string[] linkage_part(LinkageResult result)
        tree := result.tree
        path := [for row := (0:<count - 1)[] then delta[tree.order[row]][tree.order[row + 1]]].sum()
        inversions := [for step := (1:<count - 1)[] if tree.heights[step] < tree.heights[step - 1] then step]
        lines := ["linkage {result.method}", "cophenetic {real_text(result.correlation)} leaf_path {real_text(path)}", "heights min {real_text(tree.heights.min())} max {real_text(tree.heights.max())} inversions {#inversions}"]
        for step := inversions[]
            lines = lines.append("inversion step {step + 1} height {real_text(tree.heights[step])} previous {real_text(tree.heights[step - 1])}")
        ordered := tree.subtree_heights.sorted()
        gaps := [for clusters := (2:settings.gap_max_k)[] then ordered[count - clusters] - ordered[count - clusters - 1]]
        suggested := 2
        for: 3 <= clusters <= settings.gap_max_k
            if rounded_key(gaps[clusters - 2]) > rounded_key(gaps[suggested - 2])
                suggested = clusters
        lines = lines.concat(["gaps " + reals(gaps), "suggested_k {suggested}"])
        joining := tree.joining_heights()
        late := 0:<count
        for: 1 <= index < count
            value := late[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and joining[value] > joining[late[cursor - 1]]
                late[cursor] = late[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            late[cursor] = value
        lines = lines.append("late_joiners " + [for observation := late[0:<settings.list_size][] then "{idents[observation]}:{real_text(joining[observation])}"].join(" "))
        kinds := [0, 0, 0]
        for merge := tree.merges[]
            leaves := (if merge.a < count then 1 else 0) + (if merge.b < count then 1 else 0)
            kinds[2 - leaves] += 1
        int matches := match_count(result.label_partition)
        lines = lines.append("merges leaf_leaf {kinds[0]} leaf_cluster {kinds[1]} cluster_cluster {kinds[2]} depth {tree.depths[2 * count - 2]}")
        lines = lines.append("label_cut k {#classes} purity {matches}/{count} {real_text(real64(matches) / real64(count))}")
        lines = lines.append("inconsistency depth {settings.inconsistency_depth}")
        for: count - settings.inconsistency_count - 1 <= step < count - 1
            sequence := tree.height_sequence(step, settings.inconsistency_depth)
            average := sequence.sum() / real64(#sequence)
            real64 deviation := 0.0
            real64 coefficient := 0.0
            if #sequence >= 2
                deviation = math.sqrt(((sequence - average) * (sequence - average)).sum() / real64(int(#sequence) - 1))
                coefficient = (tree.heights[step] - average) / deviation
            lines = lines.append("step {step + 1} height {real_text(tree.heights[step])} mean {real_text(average)} sd {real_text(deviation)} count {#sequence} coefficient {real_text(coefficient)}")
        for: cut < int(#settings.cut_heights)
            lines = lines.append("cut height {real_text(settings.cut_heights[cut])} clusters {#result.height_cuts[cut].sizes} {result.height_cuts[cut].text()}")
        for: cut < int(#settings.cut_counts)
            lines = lines.append("cut k {settings.cut_counts[cut]} {result.count_cuts[cut].text()}")
        return lines

    string[] mst_part(LinkageResult single)
        agg.Edge[] edges := agg.minimum_spanning_tree(delta)
        weights := [for edge := edges[] then edge.weight]
        total := weights.sum()
        weights = weights.sorted()
        heights_match := true
        bool[][] linked := array(nat(count), fill = array(nat(count), fill = false))
        for: index < int(#edges)
            if math.abs(weights[index] - single.tree.heights[index]) > 0.000000001
                heights_match = false
            linked[edges[index].parent][edges[index].child] = true
            linked[edges[index].child][edges[index].parent] = true
        nearest := [for observation := (0:<count)[] if linked[observation][neighbors[observation]] then 1].sum()
        height_result := if heights_match then "match" else "mismatch"
        lines := ["mst total {real_text(total)} heights {height_result} nn_edges {nearest}/{count}"]
        numbers := 0:<int(#edges)
        for: 1 <= index < int(#numbers)
            value := numbers[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and edges[value].weight < edges[numbers[cursor - 1]].weight
                numbers[cursor] = numbers[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            numbers[cursor] = value
        for: cut < int(#settings.cut_counts)
            clusters := settings.cut_counts[cut]
            component := 0:<count
            for: step < count - clusters
                edge := edges[numbers[step]]
                old := component[edge.child]
                replacement := component[edge.parent]
                for: observation < count
                    if component[observation] == old
                        component[observation] = replacement
            partition := single.count_cuts[cut].partition
            agrees := true
            for: first < count
                for: first + 1 <= second < count
                    if (component[first] == component[second]) != (partition[first] == partition[second])
                        agrees = false
            result := if agrees then "match" else "mismatch"
            lines = lines.append("mst partition k {clusters} {result}")
        return lines

    string[] compare_part()
        method := settings.compare_linkage
        label_count := int(#classes)
        lines := ["compare linkage {method} k {label_count}"]
        for kind := metric.types()[]
            distances := metric.distance_matrix(vectors, kind)
            tree := Tree(agg.agglomerate(distances, method), count)
            partition := tree.cut_into(label_count)
            coefficient := validation.correlation(pair_values(distances), pair_values(tree.cophenetic()))
            lines = lines.append("metric {kind} cophenetic {real_text(coefficient)} silhouette {real_text(mean_silhouette(partition, distances))} ari {ari_text(label_ari(partition))}")
        return lines

    string[] cophenetic_part()
        lines := ["cophenetic_matrix", "linkage " + settings.linkages.join(" ")]
        for first := results[]
            values := [for second := results[] then validation.correlation(first.cophenetic, second.cophenetic)]
            lines = lines.append(first.method + " " + reals(values))
        return lines

    string[] agreement_part()
        lines := ["agreement k {#classes}", "linkage " + settings.linkages.join(" ")]
        for first := results[]
            real64[] values := [for second := results[] then partition_ari(first.label_partition, second.label_partition).value()]
            lines = lines.append(first.method + " " + reals(values))
        return lines

    string[] summary_part()
        ranking := 0:<int(#results)
        for: 1 <= index < int(#ranking)
            value := ranking[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and rounded_key(results[value].correlation) > rounded_key(results[ranking[cursor - 1]].correlation)
                ranking[cursor] = ranking[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ranking[cursor] = value
        lines := ["summary", "cophenetic_ranking " + [for result := ranking[] then results[result].method].join(" ")]
        for: cut < int(#settings.cut_counts)
            best := 0
            for: 1 <= result < int(#results)
                if results[result].count_cuts[cut].ari.greater(results[best].count_cuts[cut].ari)
                    best = result
            lines = lines.append("best_ari k {settings.cut_counts[cut]} {results[best].method} {ari_text(results[best].count_cuts[cut].ari)}")
        for result := results[]
            best := 0
            for: 1 <= cut < int(#settings.cut_counts)
                candidate := required_real(result.count_cuts[cut].silhouette)
                incumbent := required_real(result.count_cuts[best].silhouette)
                if rounded_key(candidate) > rounded_key(incumbent)
                    best = cut
            lines = lines.append("best_silhouette {result.method} k {settings.cut_counts[best]} {real_text(result.count_cuts[best].silhouette)}")
        return lines.append("selected {results[chosen].method} k {kappa}")

    string[] validation_report()
        string[][] parts := [data_part(), correlation_part(), histogram_part()]
        for result := results[]
            parts = parts.append(linkage_part(result))
        for result := results[]
            if result.method == "single"
                parts = parts.append(mst_part(result))
        return join_parts(parts.concat([compare_part(), cophenetic_part(), agreement_part(), summary_part()]))

    real64 separation(int[] first, int[] second)
        real64 best := inf
        for observation := first[]
            for other := second[]
                best = math.min(best, delta[observation][other])
        return best

    string[] cluster_lines(int cluster)
        group := members[cluster]
        size := int(#group)
        category := majority[cluster]
        majority_count := table[cluster][category]
        silhouette := [for observation := group[] then silhouettes[observation]].sum() / real64(size)
        original_means := [for feature := (0:<int(#names))[] then [for observation := group[] then raw[observation][feature]].sum() / real64(size)]
        medoid := -1
        real64 medoid_sum := 0.0
        int[] widest := []
        for: index < size
            observation := group[index]
            total := [for other := group[] then delta[observation][other]].sum()
            if medoid < 0 or total < medoid_sum
                medoid = observation
                medoid_sum = total
            for other := group[index + 1:][]
                if #widest == 0 or delta[observation][other] > delta[widest[0]][widest[1]]
                    widest = [observation, other]
        nearest := -1
        real64 nearest_separation := 0.0
        for: other < kappa
            if other == cluster
                continue
            real64 value := separation(group, members[other])
            if nearest < 0 or value < nearest_separation
                nearest = other
                nearest_separation = value
        string diameter := if #widest == 0 then "0.0000 - -" else pair_text(widest[0], widest[1])
        return ["cluster {cluster + 1} size {size} silhouette {real_text(silhouette)} majority {classes[category]} purity {majority_count}/{size} {real_text(real64(majority_count) / real64(size))}", "  mean " + reals(original_means), "  medoid {idents[medoid]} diameter {diameter} nearest {nearest + 1} separation {real_text(nearest_separation)}"]

    string[] selection_part()
        cut := results[chosen].count_cuts[position]
        lines := ["selected linkage {results[chosen].method} k {kappa} ari {ari_text(cut.ari)} silhouette {real_text(cut.silhouette)}"]
        for: cluster < kappa
            lines = lines.concat(cluster_lines(cluster))
        return lines

    string[] centroid_part()
        real64[][] centers := centroids(selected)
        lines := ["centroid_distances"]
        for: cluster < kappa
            real64[] values := [for center := centers[] then math.sqrt(metric.squared(centers[cluster], center))]
            lines = lines.append("{cluster + 1} " + reals(values))
        return lines

    string[] profile_part()
        width := [for name := names[] then #name].max()
        lines := ["profile_bars"]
        for: cluster < kappa
            group := members[cluster]
            lines = lines.append("cluster {cluster + 1}")
            for: feature < int(#names)
                zeta := [for observation := group[] then (raw[observation][feature] - means[feature]) / deviations[feature]].sum() / real64(#group)
                length := math.floor(math.abs(zeta) * 4.0)
                length = math.min(10, length)
                string bar := "#" * nat(length)
                string left := if zeta < 0.0 then " " * nat(10 - length) + bar else " " * 10
                string right := if zeta < 0.0 then " " * 10 else bar + " " * nat(10 - length)
                string feature_name := names[feature] + " " * (width - #names[feature])
                lines = lines.append("{feature_name} {left}|{right} {real_text(zeta)}")
        return lines

    string[] contingency_part()
        lines := ["contingency", "cluster " + classes.join(" ") + " total"]
        for: cluster < kappa
            lines = lines.append("{cluster + 1} {integers(table[cluster])} {table[cluster].sum()}")
        totals := [for category := (0:<int(#classes))[] then [for row := table[] then row[category]].sum()]
        int matches := match_count(selected)
        return lines.concat(["total {integers(totals)} {count}", "purity {matches}/{count} {real_text(real64(matches) / real64(count))}"])

    string[] misplaced_part()
        lines := ["misplaced"]
        misplaced := 0
        for: observation < count
            category := majority[selected[observation] - 1]
            if targets[observation] != category
                misplaced += 1
                lines = lines.append("{idents[observation]} label {labels[observation]} cluster {selected[observation]} majority {classes[category]}")
        return lines.append("count {misplaced}")

    string[] weakest_part()
        ordered := 0:<count
        for: 1 <= index < count
            value := ordered[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and silhouettes[value] < silhouettes[ordered[cursor - 1]]
                ordered[cursor] = ordered[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ordered[cursor] = value
        lines := ["weakest"]
        for observation := ordered[0:<settings.list_size][]
            lines = lines.append("{idents[observation]} label {labels[observation]} cluster {selected[observation]} silhouette {real_text(silhouettes[observation])}")
        return lines

    string[] feature_part()
        real64[] ratios := []
        for: feature < int(#names)
            values := [for vector := vectors[] then vector[feature]]
            overall := values.sum() / real64(count)
            cluster_means := [for group := members[] then [for observation := group[] then values[observation]].sum() / real64(#group)]
            between := [for cluster := (0:<kappa)[] then real64(#members[cluster]) * (cluster_means[cluster] - overall) * (cluster_means[cluster] - overall)].sum()
            within := [for observation := (0:<count)[] then (values[observation] - cluster_means[selected[observation] - 1]) * (values[observation] - cluster_means[selected[observation] - 1])].sum()
            ratios = ratios.append(between / real64(kappa - 1) / (within / real64(count - kappa)))
        ranking := 0:<int(#names)
        for: 1 <= index < int(#ranking)
            value := ranking[index]
            cursor := index
            while cursor > 0 and rounded_key(ratios[value]) > rounded_key(ratios[ranking[cursor - 1]])
                ranking[cursor] = ranking[cursor - 1]
                cursor -= 1
            ranking[cursor] = value
        lines := ["features"]
        for: rank < int(#ranking)
            feature := ranking[rank]
            lines = lines.append("{rank + 1} {names[feature]} f_ratio {real_text(ratios[feature])}")
        return lines

    string class_counts(Tree tree, int node)
        counts := array(#classes, fill = 0)
        for observation := tree.members[node][]
            counts[targets[observation]] += 1
        return [for frequency := counts[] then "{frequency}"].join("/")

    string[] top_merges_part()
        tree := results[chosen].tree
        lines := ["top_merges"]
        for: count - settings.inconsistency_count - 1 <= step < count - 1
            merge := tree.merges[step]
            lines = lines.append("step {step + 1} height {real_text(merge.height)} a {merge.a} {#tree.members[merge.a]} {class_counts(tree, merge.a)} b {merge.b} {#tree.members[merge.b]} {class_counts(tree, merge.b)}")
        return lines

    string[] drop_feature_part()
        lines := ["drop_feature"]
        for: feature < int(#names)
            real64[][] reduced := [for vector := vectors[] then vector[0:<feature].concat(vector[feature + 1:])]
            tree := Tree(agg.agglomerate(metric.distance_matrix(reduced, settings.distance), results[chosen].method), count)
            partition := tree.cut_into(kappa)
            lines = lines.append("{names[feature]} ari_selected {ari_text(partition_ari(partition, selected))} ari_labels {ari_text(label_ari(partition))}")
        return lines

    string[] refinement_part()
        limit := settings.refine_iterations
        iterations := limit
        real64[][] centers := centroids(selected)
        previous := selected
        for: 1 <= iteration <= limit
            int[] assignment := []
            for vector := vectors[]
                best := 0
                best_value := metric.squared(vector, centers[0])
                for: 1 <= cluster < kappa
                    value := metric.squared(vector, centers[cluster])
                    if value < best_value
                        best = cluster
                        best_value = value
                assignment = assignment.append(best + 1)
            if assignment == previous
                iterations = iteration
                break
            groups := cluster_members(assignment, kappa)
            for: cluster < kappa
                if #groups[cluster] > 0
                    centers[cluster] = centroid([for observation := groups[cluster][] then vectors[observation]])
            previous = assignment
        changed := [for observation := (0:<count)[] if selected[observation] != previous[observation] then 1].sum()
        sizes := [for group := cluster_members(previous, kappa)[] then int(#group)]
        return ["refinement max_iterations {limit}", "iterations {iterations} changed {changed} wss {real_text(within_sum(selected))} -> {real_text(within_sum(previous))}", "sizes {integers(sizes)} silhouette {real_text(mean_silhouette(previous, delta))}", "ari_selected {ari_text(partition_ari(previous, selected))} ari_labels {ari_text(label_ari(previous))}"]

    real64[] jaccard(int[] sample_partition, int[] restricted)
        counts := validation.contingency(restricted - 1, sample_partition - 1, kappa, sample_partition.max())
        columns := [for cluster := (0:<int(#counts[0]))[] then [for row := counts[] then row[cluster]].sum()]
        real64[] values := []
        for row := counts[]
            size := row.sum()
            best := validation.Fraction(0, 1)
            if size > 0
                for: cluster < int(#row)
                    candidate := validation.Fraction(row[cluster], size + columns[cluster] - row[cluster])
                    if candidate.greater(best)
                        best = candidate
            values = values.append(best.value())
        return values

    string[] stability_part()
        size := count * settings.percent / 100
        generator := Minstd(settings.seed)
        real64[] aris := []
        real64[][] jaccards := []
        lines := ["stability replicates {settings.replicates} percent {settings.percent} seed {settings.seed}"]
        for: 1 <= replicate <= settings.replicates
            order := 0:<count
            for: step < size
                draw := .generator.draw()
                other := step + draw % (count - step)
                saved := order[step]
                order[step] = order[other]
                order[other] = saved
            sample := order[0:<size].sorted()
            distances := [for first := sample[] then [for second := sample[] then delta[first][second]]]
            tree := Tree(agg.agglomerate(distances, results[chosen].method), size)
            partition := tree.cut_into(kappa)
            restricted := [for observation := sample[] then selected[observation]]
            validation.Fraction agreement := partition_ari(partition, restricted)
            real64[] similarities := jaccard(partition, restricted)
            aris = aris.append(agreement.value())
            jaccards = jaccards.append(similarities)
            lines = lines.append("replicate {replicate} size {size} ari {ari_text(agreement)} jaccard {reals(similarities)}")
        average_jaccards := [for cluster := (0:<kappa)[] then [for row := jaccards[] then row[cluster]].sum() / real64(settings.replicates)]
        return lines.concat(["mean_ari {real_text(aris.sum() / real64(settings.replicates))}", "mean_jaccard " + reals(average_jaccards)])

    string[] distance_map_part()
        order := results[chosen].tree.order
        string frame := "+" + "-" * nat(count) + "+"
        shades := "@%#*+=-:. "
        lines := ["distance_map {results[chosen].method}", frame]
        for first := order[]
            row := [for second := order[] then shades[histogram_bin(delta[first][second], distance_max)]].join("")
            lines = lines.append("|" + row + "|")
        return lines.append(frame)

    string[] profiles_report()
        return join_parts([selection_part(), centroid_part(), profile_part(), contingency_part(), misplaced_part(), weakest_part(), feature_part(), top_merges_part(), drop_feature_part(), refinement_part(), stability_part(), distance_map_part()])

void run_study()
    observations := data.read_observations("input/data.csv")
    study := Study(observations, data.read_settings("input/params.txt"))
    bool directory_exists := file.is_directory("output")
    if not directory_exists
        file.mkdir("output")
    data.write_lines("output/linkage.csv", study.linkage_table())
    data.write_lines("output/clusters.csv", study.clusters_table())
    data.write_lines("output/dendrogram.txt", study.dendrogram_report())
    data.write_lines("output/trees.txt", study.trees_report())
    data.write_lines("output/validation.txt", study.validation_report())
    data.write_lines("output/profiles.txt", study.profiles_report())

if main
    run_study()

import math

real64 correlation(real64[] first, real64[] second)
    mean_first := first.sum() / real64(#first)
    mean_second := second.sum() / real64(#second)
    centered_first := first - mean_first
    centered_second := second - mean_second
    cross := (centered_first * centered_second).sum()
    sx := (centered_first * centered_first).sum()
    sy := (centered_second * centered_second).sum()
    return cross / math.sqrt(sx * sy)

int[][] contingency(int[] first, int[] second, int rows, int columns)
    int[][] table := array(nat(rows), fill = array(nat(columns), fill = 0))
    for: position < #first
        table[first[position]][second[position]] += 1
    return table

int pair_count(int size)
    return size * (size - 1) / 2

class Fraction(int numerator, int denominator)
    real64 value()
        return real64(numerator) / real64(denominator)

    bool greater(Fraction other)
        return numerator * other.denominator > other.numerator * denominator

Fraction adjusted_rand(int[][] table)
    count := [for row := table[] then row.sum()].sum()
    same := [for row := table[] then [for cell := row[] then pair_count(cell)].sum()].sum()
    row_pairs := [for row := table[] then pair_count(row.sum())].sum()
    column_pairs := 0
    for: column < #table[0]
        column_pairs += pair_count([for row := table[] then row[column]].sum())
    total := pair_count(count)
    numerator := 2 * (total * same - row_pairs * column_pairs)
    denominator := total * (row_pairs + column_pairs) - 2 * row_pairs * column_pairs
    if denominator == 0
        return Fraction(1, 1)
    first := math.abs(numerator)
    second := math.abs(denominator)
    while second != 0
        first, second = second, first % second
    if denominator < 0
        first = -first
    return Fraction(numerator / first, denominator / first)

real64[] silhouette_values(int[] partition, int groups, real64[][] delta)
    sizes := array(nat(groups + 1), fill = 0)
    for group := partition[]
        sizes[group] += 1
    real64[] values := []
    for: position < #partition
        own := partition[position]
        if sizes[own] == 1
            values = values.append(0.0)
            continue
        real64[] sums := array(nat(groups + 1), fill = 0.0)
        for: other < #partition
            if other != position
                sums[partition[other]] += delta[position][other]
        inner := sums[own] / real64(sizes[own] - 1)
        real64 outer := inf
        for: 1 <= group <= groups
            if group != own
                outer = math.min(outer, sums[group] / real64(sizes[group]))
        values = values.append((outer - inner) / math.max(inner, outer))
    return values
